scope:
Read-only inventory of original main-Pump instruction evidence in a sealed checkpoint.

No transactions are generated or executed. Literal signed transaction counts are
separate from repeated corpus rows and observable-receipt fingerprints. Missing
serialized transactions may be attributed only from main-program-scoped logs.

coverage_definitions.reached: A main-scoped Instruction log names the IDL family, or a decoded main top-level instruction is at/before the failing instruction index (all decoded instructions on successful transactions).
coverage_definitions.success: The original transaction error field is null and the family was reached. Earlier successful invocations in failed transactions are counted separately.
coverage_definitions.signed_byte: Main instruction data is encoded directly in a serialized top-level transaction; signatures reverified offline. CPI receipt byte evidence is counted separately and requires a reverified signed outer transaction. Logs alone are not counted as instruction bytes.
coverage_definitions.distinct_observable_receipt: Hash of original outcome excluding logs/compute/signature summary fields; includes available signed bytes, state snapshots, errors, events and inner instructions. Not proof of unique complete initial states.
coverage_definitions.bootstrap: Setup bootstrap transactions are inventoried separately and excluded from tested-family counts.
coverage_definitions.limits: No path/branch completeness or live-chain acceptance claim. Most literal transactions repeat across state variants. Family counts never sum to unique test-space coverage.
